Maya Chen: Heads-up — Halcyon retrofit case study is ready for interview scheduling. Need quote+legal signoff by next Tue so we can hit the Mar 31 launch window. 
Arjun Patel: Great. Who's the primary contact at Halcyon? 
Maya Chen: Samir is our CS lead there — cc @Samir Gupta. They said execs are available next week afternoons PST.
Samir Gupta (CS): Yep, I can introduce. CTO (Aisha) prefers async first — short voice mems then 20m follow-up. Works for me.
Nora Feldman (Product): Async sounds good. We should capture a product metric for the headline — Aisha mentioned 3x inference throughput and 42% cost reduction. Need a clear attribution.
Maya Chen: Copy — we'll draft a short prompt for the async questions. Lila, any immediate legal flags on a recorded voice memo + written quote workflow?
Lila Roberts (Legal): As long as we get explicit written consent for the quote and a short release confirming we can use the voice clip and a 2-3 sentence blurb, we're fine. I can push a one-click approval template.
Diego Ramos (Design): For assets, we'll need high-res logo + 2 headshots. Can we get a short 10–15s clip for the promo?
Samir Gupta (CS): I'll request logo, headshots, and a 15s clip. Aisha likes clean backgrounds.
Maya Chen: Draft async question set (short) — please review: 1) Brief on Halcyon & role. 2) What was the main infra challenge? 3) Quantified outcome (throughput/cost). 4) A quick sentence on why they chose Redwood. 5) Anything else to call out.
Arjun Patel: Suggest adding "one unexpected win" — good soundbite.
Nora Feldman (Product): Add a follow-up asking for a short snippet on any latency SLA improvements — customers care.
Maya Chen: Updated. I'll send to Samir to share with Aisha.
transcript-bot: Reminder — please upload voice memos to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.company/halcyon-cs (auto-created).
Samir Gupta (CS): Sent to Aisha this morning. ETA for memos + headshots: Thu EOD.
Diego Ramos (Design): If assets arrive Thu, I can cut a 15s promo and hero image by Mon.
Lila Roberts (Legal): Drafted the release language. Posting here for review:
```
By submitting this quote and/or audio, you grant Redwood Inference the right to publish the materials in marketing collateral and agree that the quote is factual and may be edited for clarity without changing the meaning.
```
Maya Chen: Looks fine to me. Two asks: 1) Lila, can we make approval one-click for execs? 2) Can Legal sign off on an embargo date and minor edit policy?
Lila Roberts (Legal): Yes to one-click (we already have that flow). Embargo okay; minor edits okay as long as we send back the final copy for a courtesy review prior to publish.
Arjun Patel: Logistics q — are we routing inbound leads to SDRs or handing to AE for this launch? Nora?
Nora Feldman (Product): Launch leads go to SDRs first; if lead score >= 80 then AE. We'll wire up the Halcyon tag in HubSpot.
Maya Chen: I'll add tracking UTM and the tag. Also planning a webinar 2 weeks post-launch with Aisha as guest. Need to confirm dates.
Samir Gupta (CS): Aisha is available Apr 14–16.
Diego Ramos (Design): Webinar banner draft will be ready once we lock the hero image.
Arjun Patel: Marketing assets checklist: hero image, 15s promo, short transcript highlights, 3 pull quotes (one executive-ready), deck slide for webinar.
Maya Chen: Pull quotes candidate 1: "Redwood cut inference costs by 42% while preserving quality." Candidate 2: "We saw a 3x jump in throughput within weeks." Adding candidate 3 once I get the memos.
Samir Gupta (CS): Aisha approved candidate 1 and 2 verbally. Will push written confirmation.
transcript-bot: Transcript for voice memo 1 uploaded: https://drive.company/halcyon-cs/memo1.txt
Maya Chen: Drafting the case study doc now. I'll tag for legal and product review before Friday.
Lila Roberts (Legal): Please route the final quote language to me before sending to Aisha for one-click approval.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Halcyon: Customer Story Sync" Apr 1 10:00 PST — invites sent.
Nora Feldman (Product): Quick note on messaging: emphasize deterministic latency improvements + predictable unit cost — differentiator vs public endpoints.
Arjun Patel: Agreed — let's make that the lead paragraph.
Maya Chen: Thanks all — next check-in Fri 9am. If assets delayed, we bump webinar one week. :crossed_fingers: 
Diego Ramos (Design): Will drop initial hero comps in the thread when ready.
Samir Gupta (CS): Sent written quote from Aisha at 16:12 — "Redwood helped us scale inference and cut per-token spend by nearly half." Attaching approval.
Maya Chen: Got it, pushing to legal for one-click.
Lila Roberts (Legal): Approved. One-click sent to Aisha.
Samir Gupta (CS): Aisha clicked approve. Post embargo Mar 31 at 09:00 PT ok.
Maya Chen: Perfect — prepping launch plan + PR decks. Will share draft case study link here shortly.
Diego Ramos (Design): Uploaded hero comp v1: https://drive.company/halcyon-cs/hero-v1.png
Maya Chen: Draft shared: https://docs.company/halcyon-case-draft — please leave comments by Thu EOD.
Arjun Patel: I'll add the benchmark graph and caption.
Nora Feldman (Product): Good work team. Excited to get this live.
Maya Chen: Closing loop — webinar guest confirmed, assets in flight, legal signoff done. Will post final copy after last pass. :tada:
